parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the scheduled task list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RecurrenceType
parameters.description:
The recurrence type of the scheduled task. Valid values:

- Daily: The scheduled task is executed every specified number of days.
- Weekly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each week.
- Monthly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each month.
- Cron: The scheduled task is executed based on a specified cron expression.

parameters.name: RecurrenceValue
parameters.description:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task.

This parameter is supported only when RecurrenceType is set to Weekly. You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,). For example, the values for Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group to which the scheduled task belongs.

parameters.name: ScalingGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task.

parameters.name: ScheduledAction
parameters.description: The scaling rule used when the scheduled task is triggered. This parameter is returned only when the scheduled task specifies a scaling rule.

parameters.name: ScheduledTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the scheduled task to query.

parameters.name: ScheduledTaskName
parameters.description: The name of the scheduled task to query.

parameters.name: TaskEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the scheduled task is enabled.

- true: The task is enabled.
- false: The task is disabled.

parameters.name: TaskName
parameters.description: The task name. Fuzzy match by keyword is supported.
